lang: python
file: handled_exc_info.py
---
import logging

def fetch_timezone(cal_id):
    try:
        return load_tz(cal_id)
    except Exception:
        logging.getLogger("app").warning(
            "Failed to fetch timezone for %s",
            cal_id,
            exc_info=True,
        )
